package view
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    AddStaffDialog
    Admin form to create a Trainer, Receptionist, or Administrator account.
    AdminDashboard
    Administrator landing screen.
    CheckInDialog
    Implements the "Member Check In" use case (SRS 3.2.3).
    CheckInHistoryDialog
    Member "view check-in history" feature (SRS 2.4 Member View).
    DashboardFrame
    Shared base class for all role-specific dashboards (Admin, Trainer, Receptionist, Member).
    FitnessClassesDialog
    Implements the "Book Fitness Class" use case (SRS 3.2.4), member side.
    GymLogoPanel
    A simple logo drawn with Graphics2D (a gold badge containing a dumbbell silhouette) instead of an external image asset, so the project doesn't depend on shipping/loading an image file.
    LoginFrame
    Entry point screen implementing the "Member Login" use case (SRS 3.2.2).
    ManageMembersDialog
    Shared "Manage Members" feature (used by both Receptionist and Admin dashboards): lists members with their current membership status, and lets staff renew or suspend a membership.
    ManageUsersDialog
    Admin "Manage Users" / "User Management" feature: list, add, suspend, activate, delete accounts.
    MemberDashboard
    Member landing screen: profile/membership status, class booking, self check-in, and attendance history (SRS 2.4 Member View).
    MembershipPlansDialog
    Admin "Membership Plans" feature: view/add/update/delete pricing tiers.
    MyClassesDialog
    Trainer feature: schedule and manage fitness classes.
    MyMembershipDialog
    Member "check their personal subscription status" feature (SRS 2.3).
    PaymentsHistoryDialog
    Admin view of all payment transactions logged by the system.
    ProcessPaymentDialog
    Implements the "Process Membership Payment" use case (SRS 3.2.5).
    ReceptionistDashboard
    Receptionist landing screen: registration, check-in, and payment processing - the daily front-desk operations described in SRS 2.3.
    RegisterMemberDialog
    Implements the "Register Member" use case (SRS 3.2.1).
    ReportsDialog
    Admin "Generate Reports" feature: operational summary (SRS 2.2, 4.3 performance target 10s).
    RosterDialog
    Trainer feature: view registered participants for a selected class.
    TrainerDashboard
    Trainer landing screen: manage class schedule and view class rosters (SRS 2.2 Trainer Scheduling).
    UiTheme
    Shared visual identity for the system: a purple brand palette and a clean sans-serif type scale, applied to the Login screen (SRS 4.6 Usability: "a simple, consistent, and intuitive design utilizing a standard color theme").
